subject: CS240
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. For English, high-quality, popular videos were available for all topics, including lectures from MIT and classics from educators like Abdul Bari and Sebastian Lague. For Arabic, strong candidates were found for Knapsack, N-Queens, and Minimax. However, no suitable Arabic videos were found for the specific mathematical analysis of Randomized Quicksort or for the Skip List data structure, with search results pointing to irrelevant or overly general topics.

coverage.note: All candidates were too general (e.g., Big-O notation) and failed the relevance gate; none covered the specific probabilistic analysis required.

videos.title: 6.1 N Queens Problem using Backtracking
videos.filter_reason: With millions of views, this video is a definitive guide that masterfully visualizes the state-space tree and the backtracking process for the N-Queens problem.

videos.title: Algorithms Explained – minimax and alpha-beta pruning
videos.topic_ar: خوارزمية ميني ماكس مع تقليم ألفا-بيتا
videos.filter_reason: This video uses exceptional animations to intuitively explain the alternating min/max layers and how alpha-beta bounds prune the search tree, making a confusing topic very clear.

videos.title: [Arabic] CS Master- 1.5.2- 0/1 Knapsack Problem مسألة حقيبة الظهر
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive and in-depth Arabic tutorial that thoroughly explains the 0/1 Knapsack problem, perfectly addressing the student need for a detailed walkthrough.

videos.title: Search Techniques - Backtracking (Arabic)
videos.filter_reason: From a respected competitive programming channel, this video provides a clear and focused explanation of backtracking using the N-Queens problem as a primary example.
